name: PingOne LAB
description: A card for each thing PingOne can do for apps and AI agents that its discovery document advertises: pi.flow sign-in, PKCE, PAR, JAR, client credentials, token lifecycle, Userinfo, device authorization, CIBA, token exchange and a playground. Runs on a mock PingOne or your own environment.
notes: Host-run: npm install && npm run build && npm start (http://127.0.0.1:5500, loopback only). Mock by default: no settings needed, and mock sign-in is on for the demo user. Docker: docker compose up --build -d (mock by default, no .env needed; publishes 127.0.0.1:5500 only). Live mode and https: docker-compose.live.yml and the README. Catalog id A29 was accepted by the owner on 2026-10-31.
